application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Condition 7 (Preservation and Enhancement and Benefit of Wildlife) is subject to the findings of Condition 6 (Bat Survey). in failing to discharge Condition 6, which is a perquisite requirement for Condition 7, Condition 7 cannot be lawfully discharged. The details provided are thereby considered unacceptable and contrary to Policies G6 of the London Plan (2021), CP36 of the Core Strategy (2010), DMD 78 and DMD 79 of the Development Management Document (2014) as well as biodiversity aims outlined within the NPPF (2024).
description: Details submitted pursuant to appeal reference APP/Q5300/W/22/3300255 (21/01248/FUL): preservation and enhancement and benefit of wildlife (7) in respect of demolition of existing public house (sui-generis) and construction of part 3, part 4, part 5 storey residential building (Class C3) with ground floor public house (Use Class E / Sui-generis) and associated cycle and car parking, refuse storage and external landscaping.
